instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_08_l_bracket.dxf from /home/user/Desktop using the GUI DXF import workflow (File > Import), then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Modify the existing bracket outline into the final L-shaped bracket: horizontal leg length 120, vertical leg height 90, and material thickness 20. Add a diameter 10 hole at the horizontal leg end with center (90,10), and a diameter 10 hole in the vertical leg with center (10,60). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_08.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export. You must complete all modeling and editing operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files, shell commands, Python, ezdxf, raw DXF/text/file writes, or helper code to create or edit the final DXF is strictly prohibited.
